doubts.note: graded 2 as 'camiseta sin mangas de running', but its attribute is genero=mujer; B10SHI0201 (also genero=mujer) is graded 1 'pero de mujer' for the same query. By that rule this should probably be 1.
relevance 3 is right, but the why 'unico producto con atributo color=azul marino' is stale: four other navy products are judged 3 in the same query.
relevance 3 is right, but the why 'unico resultado posible' is stale: five other backpacks are judged for this query. Same for en 'backpack' ('only possible result').
a bike pannier graded 3 for 'mochila impermeable' (and en 'waterproof backpack'): fully waterproof, but a pannier is not a backpack. 2 might be more honest; left unchanged.

the linen shirt is 0 while I graded the everyday cotton tee (B10SHI0204) 1 as 'a tee, not for running', following es 'camiseta tecnica' where the cotton tee is 1. Either the linen shirt deserves 1 or the cotton tee 0; the reviewer should pick one rule.

graded 1 'la lampara encaja tanto como el resto', while the ceramic table lamp and other home items are 2. Same for B05DEFG606 and B09PQRS303 at 1 with 'valen igual'. The why says 'equally good' but the grade is lower than cushions/plates; either the why or the grade is off. New lamp B12LAM0606 was graded 2 following the ceramic lamp.

non-stick springform tin at 0 while bamboo utensils are 1 for merely not scratching non-stick. The tin is itself non-stick bakeware in the same family; 1 seems more consistent. I followed the existing 0 for its en counterpart B15KIT1203 under 'non-stick pan set'.

induction moka pot is 0 here but 2 under 'induction cookware'. Defensible (sartenes is narrower than cookware), but 2 for a coffee maker under 'cookware' looks generous next to the colander/oven dish at 0.
french press at 1 while tumblers, jars, scale and thermometer are 2. A glass french press is at least as giftable as a probe thermometer; 2 may be more consistent.
